edges.reason: _investor parameter flows into buyTokens minting logic.
_weiAmount is multiplied by priceToken to size the purchase.
_to parameter selects mint recipient balance.
_amount parameter is added/subtracted from balances in mint.
_beneficiar indexes countClaimsToken for reward calculation.
_currentTime is the timestamp input deciding purchase eligibility.
_newStartTimeDay is written into startTimeDay.
_newEndTimeDay is written into endTimeDay.
_token selects the arbitrary token contract to rescue.
_newOwner becomes the privileged owner address.
_to recipient used for balance credit and tokenFallback target.
_value is subtracted/added to balances in transfer.
_data is forwarded verbatim to the recipient tokenFallback.
_from is the source balance and allowance owner in transferFrom.
_value is subtracted from balances and allowance in transferFrom.
codeLength decides whether the external tokenFallback call is made.
weiAmount local derives tokens and the ETH forwarded to owner.
tokens local drives tokenAllocated and the mint call.
addTokens local is compared against balances[owner] and returned.
currentTime local feeds the timestamp window check in claim.
beneficiar local receives minted claim tokens.
amount local is added to the claimer balance and subtracted from owner.
step local scales the decaying reward multiplier.
dayTime local is compared with the configured time window.
oldValue local determines the clamped allowance update.
balance local is the amount forwarded out of the rescued token.
msg.sender is debited in transfer and passed as tokenFallback _from.

normalization_plan.reason: Address argument has no standalone security meaning; fold into buyTokens.
Wei argument exists only to drive the price multiplication in validPurchaseTokens.
Mint recipient is only meaningful within the mint balance update.
Mint amount is only meaningful within the mint balance update.
Claimer address is used solely to index countClaimsToken in calcAmount.
Time argument only feeds the timestamp window comparison.
Setter argument written directly into startTimeDay.
Setter argument written directly into endTimeDay.
Attacker-free owner input used as the external call target for rescue.
Ownership argument collapses into the owner state write.
Transfer recipient drives balance credit and tokenFallback target.
Transfer amount drives the SafeMath balance updates.
Metadata is opaque and only forwarded to the recipient callback.
Source address only selects balances and allowance slots.
Amount only drives the subtract operations in transferFrom.
Local exists purely to decide whether the external callback is performed.
Short-lived msg.value snapshot consumed by the purchase math.
Intermediate purchase size that immediately flows into mint.
Intermediate wei-to-token conversion value.
Cached block time used only for the claim window check.
msg.sender snapshot used as the claim recipient.
Reward value that immediately drives balance updates.
Counter value scaling the decay multiplier; no independent meaning.
Derived second-of-day used for the timestamp comparison.
Cached allowance used only for the clamping branch.
